blocks.title: Raw Supari Feeding & Pre-Cleaning
desc: Raw betelnut is first fed into the system where initial impurities such as dust, leaves, and light foreign particles are removed.
blocks.note: Ensures removal of large and light impurities before further processing.

blocks.title: Fine Cleaning & Destoning
desc: The material is then passed through advanced cleaning systems to remove stones, sand, and heavy contaminants.
blocks.note: Critical step to protect downstream machinery and ensure product purity.

blocks.title: Supari Cutting / Size Reduction
desc: Clean betelnuts are processed through cutting machines to achieve desired size and shape depending on product requirement (chips, granules, etc.).
blocks.note: Precision cutting ensures uniform size for consistent mixing and roasting.

blocks.title: Grading & Air Classification
desc: After cutting, the material is graded to separate different sizes and remove fine dust or unwanted particles.
blocks.note: Ensures uniformity and improves final product quality.

blocks.title: Roasting / Drying Process
desc: The graded supari is roasted or dried to reduce moisture content and enhance flavor, texture, and shelf life.
blocks.note: Controlled temperature ensures perfect crunchiness and consistency.

blocks.title: Cooling Process
desc: Post roasting, the product is cooled to stabilize moisture and prevent condensation.
blocks.note: Maintains product integrity before further processing.

blocks.title: Flavoring & Mixing (Optional)
desc: Depending on the final product, supari is mixed with flavors, perfumes, and additives.
blocks.note: Ensures uniform coating and flavor distribution.

blocks.title: Final Sieving & Quality Check
desc: Final screening is done to remove any inconsistencies and ensure premium quality output.

blocks.title: Packaging
desc: Finished product is packed into pouches or containers using automated packaging systems.
blocks.note: High-speed packing suitable for commercial-scale production.

shortName: Coconut Water – (Tender Coconut Water, Packed & Bottled)
h1: Coconut Water Plant & Machinery Solutions (Extraction, Thermal Treatment & Packing)
metaTitle: Coconut Water Processing Plant & Machinery | Turnkey Packing Lines
metaDesc: Complete coconut water processing plant solutions covering dehusking, water extraction, filtration, thermal treatment, filling and packing. Turnkey machinery lines.
intro:
Coconut water is a natural beverage drawn from young and mature coconuts and sold as a packaged ready-to-drink product in retail, HoReCa and export markets. shortName: Roasted Grams – (Roasted Chana, Bhuna Chana, Roasted Bengal Gram)
h1: Roasted Gram Plant & Machinery Solutions (Roasted Chana Processing Line)
metaTitle: Roasted Gram Plant & Machinery | Roasted Chana Processing Line
metaDesc: Complete roasted gram (chana) processing plant solutions covering cleaning, de-stoning, roasting, cooling, grading, flavouring and packing. Turnkey machinery.
intro:
Roasted gram — widely known as roasted chana or bhuna chana — is a popular roasted snack and cooking ingredient consumed across South Asia, the Middle East and export markets, sold plain, salted, masala-coated or as split roasted gram. Producing it consistently calls for thorough cleaning, reliable de-stoning, uniform roasting, controlled cooling and accurate grading before the product reaches the packing line.
ART Mechatronics provides complete turnkey solutions for roasted gram processing plants, covering cleaning and de-stoning, roasting, cooling, grading, flavouring and automated packing. Our systems are engineered for continuous operation, consistent product quality, effective dust control and hygienic food-grade construction suitable for domestic and export production.

h1: Building Material Plant & Machinery Solutions (Cement, Mortar, Sand, Fly Ash & Mineral Handling Systems)
metaTitle: Building Material Plant Machinery | Grinding, Silos & Bagging
metaDesc: Engineering solutions for building material plants: grinding, screening, conveying, storage silos, dust collection and bagging systems. Turnkey ART Mechatronics.
intro:
The building material industry covers cement and clinker grinding, ready-mix concrete, dry mix mortar and wall putty, sand and aggregate, stone and tile, fly ash and gypsum — all of them bulk, abrasive and dust-heavy materials. Plants in this sector depend on dependable size reduction, screening, enclosed conveying, silo storage, plant-wide dust control and accurate bagging to keep production continuous and the working environment clean.
ART Mechatronics supplies the process and material-handling equipment that goes into building material plants rather than the end-product forming machines. We engineer grinding and classification systems, screening and separation, belt, screw, pneumatic and bucket conveying, storage silos and feed bins, centralised dust collection and pollution control, and automated bagging and palletising lines — delivered as one integrated turnkey engineering solution.

metaTitle: Rubber Industry Plant & Machinery | Handling, Mixing & Dust Control
metaDesc: Plant equipment for rubber manufacturing units — powder and filler handling, conveying, pre-blending, material handling, dust and fume extraction, and automation.
intro:
The rubber industry converts natural and synthetic rubber, carbon black, mineral fillers and process chemicals into products such as tyres, tubes, seals, gaskets, O rings, gloves, conveyor belts, mats and flooring. Behind every rubber product line sits a demanding materials environment — fine powders, heavy bag handling, airborne dust and process fumes that must be controlled for product consistency and worker safety.
ART Mechatronics supplies the process and utility equipment that feeds and supports rubber manufacturing plants: powder and filler intake, screening, weighing and dosing, dry pre-blending, mechanical and pneumatic conveying, material handling, dust and fume extraction, and plant automation. Compounding, moulding, curing and tyre-building machinery are outside our scope — our work is the upstream handling and environmental systems built around those lines.

Converting, cutting, slitting, creasing and finishing operations generate large volumes of paper dust, loose fibre and edge trim, while finished reels, reams and cartons demand constant, organised movement across the plant.
ART Mechatronics supplies the supporting plant equipment that paper mills and converting units depend on: dust, fibre and trim extraction, pneumatic and mechanical conveying, waste paper baling, material handling and lifting, counting and stacking, secondary packing, palletising and plant-wide automation. Paper machines, pulping lines and printing presses are outside our scope — our work is the extraction, handling and packing systems built around them.

sections.title: Complete Plant Based Food Process Flow

blocks.title: Raw Material Intake & Handling
desc: Fruits, vegetables, potatoes, pulses, grains and plant-based ingredients are received from farms and suppliers and fed into the line.
blocks.note: Ensures smooth and controlled material flow.

blocks.title: Cleaning, Washing & Peeling (CRITICAL STEP)
desc: Raw materials are cleaned and washed to remove soil, dust and surface impurities, then peeled where the product requires it.

blocks.title: Sorting, Grading & Inspection
desc: Discoloured, damaged or undersized material is separated so only sound produce continues into the process.

blocks.title: Cutting, Slicing & Dicing (CORE PROCESS)
desc: Cleaned produce is cut into the shapes required by the finished product — fries, cubes, slices, shreds or chunks.

items: Product shapes suited to fries, frozen snacks and canned packs

blocks.title: Mixing, Blanching, Cooking & Frying (CORE PROCESS)
desc: Depending on the product, material is mixed or batter-coated, blanched, cooked in kettles or fried before it moves forward.

blocks.text: All contact surfaces are food-grade and dedicated to vegetarian production.

blocks.title: Freezing & Cooling (VERY IMPORTANT FOR FROZEN FOODS)
desc: Processed product is frozen or cooled under controlled conditions before it reaches the packing line.

items: Stable product for storage and transport

blocks.title: Inspection & Packaging (HIGH-SPEED FMCG)
desc: Finished product is weighed, inspected and packed into pouches, trays, jars or cartons as required.

items: Pickle and canned fruit and vegetable packs

blocks.title: Raw Material, Powder & Filler Intake
desc: Bagged and bulk materials such as carbon black, mineral fillers, process chemicals and rubber crumb are received and tipped into the plant in a contained manner.
blocks.note: Keeps material intake contained and dust controlled at source.

blocks.title: Conveying & Feeding
desc: Powders, granules and crumb are moved between intake, storage and downstream equipment through enclosed routes.

blocks.title: Screening & Metal Separation
desc: Incoming powders and recovered rubber crumb are screened to remove lumps, oversize particles and tramp metal before further use.
blocks.note: Protects downstream equipment and keeps material consistent.

blocks.title: Weighing, Dosing & Dry Pre-Blending (CORE SUPPORT PROCESS)
desc: Fillers, chemicals and additives are weighed to recipe and dry blended before they are handed over to the compounding line.

items: Uniform distribution of fillers and additives

blocks.text: Scope note: ART Mechatronics supplies the dry-side handling, weighing and blending equipment only. Compounding, moulding, curing and tyre-building machinery are not part of our range.

blocks.title: Dust & Fume Extraction (CRITICAL STAGE)
desc: Dust from powder handling, weighing and grinding areas, and fumes from downstream rubber processing, are captured at source and treated before discharge.

items: Reduced carbon black and filler carry-over

blocks.title: Material Handling, Packing & Dispatch
desc: Compounded stock, moulded components and finished rubber goods are moved between departments and floors, then packed and stacked for dispatch.
blocks.note: Reduces manual handling across the plant.

blocks.title: Automation & Plant Controls
desc: Intake, dosing, blending, conveying and extraction systems are interlocked and operated from a common control platform.
blocks.note: Provides recipe control, interlocks and process visibility.

metaDesc: Complete dairy milk processing plant and machinery from ART Mechatronics — material handling, processing, quality control and packaging, engineered as one turnkey line.
intro: Dairy Milk is processed within the milk industry, where raw material is cleaned, processed and packed into a consistent, market-ready product. ART Mechatronics builds the complete dairy milk line — material handling, processing, quality control and packaging — as one integrated system, engineered around the product, the capacity and the hygiene standard the plant has to meet.

blocks.text: Dairy Milk is processed within the milk industry, where raw material is cleaned, processed and packed into a consistent, market-ready product. ART Mechatronics builds the complete dairy milk line — material handling, processing, quality control and packaging — as one integrated system, engineered around the product, the capacity and the hygiene standard the plant has to meet.

blocks.title: Raw Material Reception & Storage
desc: Raw dairy milk or plant-based raw materials such as soy, oat, rice, almond and coconut are received, weighed and held under controlled conditions before processing.
blocks.note: Ensures a hygienic and continuous supply to the process line.

blocks.title: Preparation, Extraction & Clarification
desc: Soaked grains, nuts or coconut are wet ground and the liquid extract is separated from the solid residue. For dairy milk, the same stage covers clarification and separation of the incoming milk.

items: A clean and uniform liquid base
Removal of coarse solids and residue

blocks.title: Blending & Standardisation (CORE PROCESS)
desc: The liquid base is blended with water, stabilisers, sweeteners or fortification ingredients to reach the required recipe.

blocks.title: Thermal Treatment (CRITICAL STAGE)
desc: The blended milk is heat treated and held for the required time before rapid cooling.

blocks.title: Homogenising
desc: Heat-treated milk is homogenised so that the fat and solid phase is broken down and evenly distributed.
blocks.note: Prevents separation and gives a smooth, uniform mouthfeel.

blocks.title: Cooling, Chilled Storage & Powder Conversion
desc: Processed milk is cooled and held in chilled storage until filling. Where milk powder is the finished format, the concentrated liquid is dried and the powder is sifted before packing.
blocks.note: Covers both liquid and powder routes from a single processing line.

blocks.title: Filling & Packaging
desc: Finished milk is filled into bottles, pouches or cartons, then sealed, coded and labelled.
blocks.note: Suitable for retail bottles, pouches and bulk formats.

blocks.title: Raw Material Reception & Storage
desc: Raw dairy milk or plant-based raw materials such as soy, oat, rice, almond and coconut are received, weighed and held under controlled conditions before processing.
blocks.note: Ensures a hygienic and continuous supply to the process line.

blocks.title: Preparation, Extraction & Clarification
desc: Soaked grains, nuts or coconut are wet ground and the liquid extract is separated from the solid residue. For dairy milk, the same stage covers clarification and separation of the incoming milk.

items: A clean and uniform liquid base
Removal of coarse solids and residue

blocks.title: Blending & Standardisation (CORE PROCESS)
desc: The liquid base is blended with water, stabilisers, sweeteners or fortification ingredients to reach the required recipe.

blocks.title: Thermal Treatment (CRITICAL STAGE)
desc: The blended milk is heat treated and held for the required time before rapid cooling.

blocks.title: Homogenising
desc: Heat-treated milk is homogenised so that the fat and solid phase is broken down and evenly distributed.
blocks.note: Prevents separation and gives a smooth, uniform mouthfeel.

blocks.title: Cooling, Chilled Storage & Powder Conversion
desc: Processed milk is cooled and held in chilled storage until filling. Where milk powder is the finished format, the concentrated liquid is dried and the powder is sifted before packing.
blocks.note: Covers both liquid and powder routes from a single processing line.

blocks.title: Filling & Packaging
desc: Finished milk is filled into bottles, pouches or cartons, then sealed, coded and labelled.
blocks.note: Suitable for retail bottles, pouches and bulk formats.

sections.title: Complete Dried Fruit & Vegetable Process Flow
sections.key: COMPLETE DRIED FRUIT & VEGETABLE PROCESS FLOW

blocks.title: Raw Material Intake & Pre-Cleaning
desc: Harvested produce is received, tipped and fed onto the line while loose soil, leaves and field trash are removed.
blocks.note: Ensures an even and controlled feed to the washing stage.

blocks.title: Washing & Sorting (CRITICAL STEP)
desc: Produce is washed to remove soil, surface residues and contaminants, then inspected, sorted and graded.

items: Removal of damaged and off-colour material

blocks.title: Peeling, Cutting & Size Reduction (CORE PROCESS)
desc: Graded produce is peeled, de-stemmed or de-seeded as required and cut to the shape needed for the finished format.

blocks.title: Blanching
desc: Cut produce is blanched and then cooled before drying or freezing.
blocks.note: Helps retain colour, texture and natural flavour.

blocks.title: Drying or Freezing (FORMAT-DEFINING STAGE)
desc: Depending on the finished format, the product is either dried under controlled conditions or frozen and moved into cold storage.

items: Dried and dehydrated fruit and vegetables

blocks.title: Pulping, Paste & Powder Preparation
desc: For liquid and powder formats, prepared produce is crushed and refined into pulp, puree or paste, or milled into powder after drying.

blocks.title: Packaging
desc: Finished product is weighed and packed into pouches, trays, cartons or bulk formats, with inline checks before dispatch.
blocks.note: Suitable for retail, foodservice and bulk export packs.

blocks.title: Reel, Board & Raw Material Handling
desc: Paper reels, board bundles and waste paper bales are received and moved into the plant and between production floors.
blocks.note: Reduces manual lifting and damage to reels and board.

blocks.title: Dust, Fibre & Trim Extraction (CRITICAL STAGE)
desc: Paper dust, loose fibre and edge trim generated at cutting, slitting, sheeting, creasing and converting stations are captured at source.

items: Fewer dust-related print and coating defects
Safer handling of combustible paper dust

blocks.title: Trim & Waste Paper Conveying and Baling
desc: Collected trim, shredded rejects and waste paper are transported to a central point and compacted for recycling or resale.
blocks.note: Turns loose trim into compact, handleable bales.

blocks.title: Counting, Stacking & Primary Packing
desc: Sheets, reams, rolls and cartons are counted, stacked and given their first wrap or pack.
machines: L Sealer With Heat Shrink Tunnel

items: Protection from moisture and handling damage

blocks.title: Secondary Packaging, Coding & Inspection
desc: Primary packs are collated into master cartons, coded, weighed and checked before dispatch.
blocks.note: Ensures correct pack counts, batch coding and traceability.

blocks.title: Palletising & Dispatch
desc: Cartons and bundles are stacked onto pallets and secured for warehousing and transport.
blocks.note: Stabilises loads for storage and export.

blocks.title: Automation & Plant Controls
desc: Extraction, conveying, packing and palletising equipment is interlocked and monitored from a common control platform.
blocks.note: Provides interlocks, line coordination and process visibility.
